command: cargo bench -p xshi --profile profiling --features profiling --bench bench small_corpus -- --sample-size 10 --warm-up-time 0.5 --measurement-time 1
notes: Quick local Criterion baseline for small-script front-end floor overhead, not a release-quality Linux profiling baseline.
The corpus is selected from checked-in .xsh files with at most 200 lines and 16 KiB.
Files that do not parse or check cleanly as standalone scripts are excluded so the benchmark measures ordinary individual-script frontend cost.
Times are Criterion mean estimates from this session on the local machine.
Allocation stats are printed by the benchmark's frontend allocation audit.
The parse/check/lower frontend helper uses an explicit cwd so this corpus lens does not measure host current_dir() syscall latency once per file.
The benchmark prints aggregate phase totals and the slowest source phase splits during setup.
